statusPolicy.meaning: A test passes only after an actual browser observation recorded with build, browser, viewport, steps, and evidence; automated Node tests never mark graphical cases PASS.

scenarios.name: After the Storm / Isla Nublar
scenarios.focus: legacy-vs-party save isolation; stealth, keycard, power and rescue; active predator risks

scenarios.name: The Long Count
scenarios.focus: survey objectives, local NPC dialogue, sightings, optional quiet-path outcome

scenarios.name: Tidal Nursery
scenarios.focus: estuary routes, Parasaurolophus wonder, earned samples/signal and non-combat completion

modes.label: Party
modes.assertion: Player controls all survivors; camera changes do not spend turns

modes.label: Character / Focus
modes.assertion: One selected player actor; AI companions take other legal turns

modes.label: Spectator
modes.assertion: Pause, resume and single-step autonomous actions; view is never omniscient

browserTargets.scope: targeted parity rerun of at least all three scenarios and modes
touch, orientation, save/restore, audio gesture and at least all three scenarios and modes
touch, orientation, save/restore and at least all three scenarios and modes
keyboard, resize, save, media and a representative scenario

flows.name: Startup/selection
flows.expect: Only playable packages can start; distinct scenario title, seed and starting location; legacy incident isolated.

flows.name: Character lab/roster
flows.expect: 1-8 validated characters where supported; edit, regenerate, locks, roster export and launch; invalid entries blocked.

flows.name: Modes and camera
flows.expect: Party/Focus/Spectator transitions pause safely and do not alter action count, dice, RNG or inventory; focus ownership differs from camera.

flows.name: Narrative and checks
flows.expect: Commands, context, legal interactions, failed checks and pushed rolls produce engine-consistent logs; unknown commands cannot invent results.

flows.name: Equipment and inventory
flows.expect: Real local item acquisition/consumption; no duplicated gear or remote transfers; sheet matches authoritative view.

flows.name: Animals and NPCs
flows.expect: Quiet/wonder scenes possible; detected threats respect distance/visibility; NPC facts, dialogue and reactions follow physical evidence.

flows.name: Combat/peril
flows.expect: Only source-legal encounters; turn/reaction timing, armor, damage, stress/critical effects and retreat reflect accepted runtime, not future modules.

flows.name: Save/load/recovery
flows.expect: Export/autosave/reload, historical bindings, invalid-save handling, separate solo/Party/Hub demo keys and no silent overwrite.

flows.name: Responsive/keyboard/touch/a11y
flows.expect: No clipped critical controls, trapped focus, inaccessible pointer-only actions or inaccessible feedback across viewports.

flows.name: Hub/map/portraits
flows.expect: Mark demo/reference-only until integrated; when integrated, observer projections, zoom/fog, portrait health/stress, toggles and layout are tested.

flows.name: Optional media/Worker
flows.expect: Without permissions/network, gameplay remains operable; silence/mute/gesture/load failures do not advance turns or reveal hidden facts.
